$description: UI-02 A2 semantic token sheet. DTCG Format Module 2025.10 (Final Community Group Report, 2025-10-28). Names obey 5.1.1 character restrictions: no leading $, no { } or . inside names. Every token has an explicit $type (8 'every design token MUST use one of these types'); color/dimension values follow 8.1/8.2.

color.$description: Base palette + semantic aliases. Alias chain: color.action -> color.brand -> color.primary (chained refs, format 7.2.2).

brand.$description: Alias: resolves to the FULL $value of color.primary (format 7.1.1).

action.$description: Chained alias: action -> brand -> primary. Deep aliases allowed (format 7.2.2, resolver 6.3).

onAction.$description: Alias for text/icon on action surfaces.

focusRing.$description: Focus indicator color reused from brand. WCAG 2.4.13 (AAA) requires >=3:1 contrast between focused/unfocused states; color value alone does not certify that.

size.$description: Dimensions per 8.2: value number + unit in {px, rem}.

targetMin.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) AA: at least 24 by 24 CSS px.

focusRingWidth.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 Focus Appearance AAA: >= 2 CSS px thick perimeter of unfocused component.

controlHeight.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) AAA reference; also a comfortable pointer target.

layout.$description: Density-aware overrides live in the resolver, not here.
